intro: Football is Nigeria's biggest sport, and the Super Eagles and Super Falcons have won many African titles.

chapters.title: Football
text: Nigeria won Olympic football gold in 1996. The men have won three Africa Cups of Nations, and the women's Super Falcons have won the African championship a record ten times.

chapters.title: Athletics
text: Tobi Amusan holds the world record in the 100 m hurdles. Many top athletes with Nigerian roots compete for other countries too.
